A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same FireScope research work and complete 26-page documents, including supplementary material. Text, equations, tables, and figures support reliable comparison; pages 2–26 render identically.

before.justification: v1 reports original wildfire-prediction experiments, ablations, expert-study outcomes, and automated interpretability evaluations in Tables 1–5, plus an MMMU evaluation in supplementary Section 12.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental and expert-study results, including Tables 1–5 and the supplementary MMMU evaluation.

M1.justification: The GRPO-trained Qwen Oracle, scalar conditioning through FiLM, raster encoder-decoder, and training objectives are identical in Sections 4 and 10.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same USA wildfire-risk data, European wildfire events and controls, and supplementary MMMU multiple-choice evaluation. No dataset, task, or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical: AlphaEarth, SegFormer, and U-Net with the same conditioning variants; Climate MLP, FWI, GPT-5, and Qwen Oracle comparisons; and the same decoder and enlarged-training-set ablations.

E3.justification: Data splits, preprocessing, metrics, model configurations, training budgets, and testing procedures are unchanged. The expert study retains the same 50 areas and two experts.

E4.justification: Both retain the same data-scaling and direct-decoder ablations, CoT perturbation and paraphrasing analyses, expert study, error-distribution analyses, and supplementary qualitative examples.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including the expert-study QWK results and significance wording. No repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or statistical testing procedures are added or removed.

E6.justification: Numerical and qualitative results match throughout Tables 1–5 and the figures. For example, U-Net with CoT retains OOD event Brier score 0.191 and ROC AUC 0.750 in Table 1; supplementary MMMU accuracy remains 51.12%.

T1.justification: Equations 1–17 are unchanged, including the reward, loss, fidelity, consistency, evaluation-metric, and GRPO formulations. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same benchmark and reasoning-to-generation contributions, novelty assertions, and claims about generalization and interpretability.

C2.justification: The interpretations of climate overfitting and reasoning-based conditioning remain identical. The scalar communication bottleneck, computational limits on sensitivity analysis, and discussion of retained general-purpose capabilities are also unchanged.

D1.justification: Architecture details, hyperparameters, hardware, training times, preprocessing, and prompts are unchanged in the main text and supplement. Both retain the same statement that data and source code will be made publicly available.

R1.justification: Section 2, all 64 references, and the paper's positioning relative to reasoning models, raster generation, and wildfire modeling are identical.

P1.justification: The first page removes Danda Pani Paudel's ETH Zurich affiliation and expands Sofia University's name with "St. Kliment Ohridski". The arXiv version/date stamp changes from v1, 21 November 2025, to v3, 6 March 2026. Scientific prose and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: All 14 figures and five tables retain their content, captions, formatting, and placement. Page organization is unchanged; first-page differences are confined to affiliation text and the arXiv stamp.

improvement.justification: The revision updates only first-page affiliations and version/date information. Scientific content, empirical evidence, limitations, reproducibility information, and supplementary material remain identical, establishing no meaningful change in overall paper quality.
